description: Generated destroy. Pins cluster_id-required and the negative-id refusal (both through the bypass), the confirm-alone destroy gate, a string that is not a confirmation, and the confirmed+bypassed POST.

cases.name: confirm alone is blocked by the destroy gate
cases.expect_error:
linode_lke_cluster_recycle is destructive. Either:
  1. Call with dry_run: true first to preview, then call again with
     confirm: true, confirmed_dry_run: true
  2. Call with confirm: true, confirm_bypass_dry_run: true to skip preview
  3. Use yolo: true (only if profile allows)

cases.name: a truthy string is not a confirmation
cases.expect_error: Recycles all nodes in the cluster. This causes temporary disruption. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: a negative cluster_id is refused
cases.expect_error: cluster_id must be a positive integer
